newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Burswood to raise up to A$123 mln.
newsitem.headline: Burswood to raise up to A$123 mln.

text.p: Burswood Property Trust said on Tuesday that it would raise up to A$123 million through the issue of shares to Metroplex Bhd of Malaysia.

Burswood it would take direct control of the Burswood hotel and casino following an agreement between Burswood Resort Management Ltd (BRML) and Victoria Co Ltd of Japan, the owner of the hotel, and Metroplex.
It said this agreement supersedes the previous heads of agreement announced by Victoria Co and Metroplex in December.
BRML and Victoria Co have also agreed to cancel the Burswood Casino operation management agreement for A$89.5 million.
It said Burswood Trust will purchase Victoria Co's units in the BML Trust, which has a 50 percent interest in the project management agreement, for A$3 million.
Burswood said it has also agreed to make an offer to purchase the hotel for A$97 million in five years time and it would also buy Victoria Co's shares in BRML for A$500,000.
It said earnings per share should be enhanced.
It added the group will also have the opportunity to expand its junket business into more Asian markets through its relationship with Metroplex.
Burswood said the share issue is subject to regulatory and shareholder approval. It said this announcement would lift the trading halt on its shares.
Burswood last traded at A$1.31, one cent up.
